name: inner_where
sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.id) FROM parent p JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id WHERE c.state='open' GROUP BY p.id

name: left_filter
sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.state='open') FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id

name: left_where
sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.id) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id WHERE c.state='open' GROUP BY p.id

name: left_on
sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.id) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id AND c.state='open' GROUP BY p.id

name: left_case
sql: SELECT p.id, SUM(CASE WHEN c.state='open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id

name: child_group
sql: SELECT c.parent_id, COUNT(*) FROM child c WHERE c.state='open' GROUP BY c.parent_id

name: parent_group
sql: SELECT p.region, COUNT(c.id) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.region

name: preaggregated_child
sql: SELECT p.id, COALESCE(x.n, 0) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN (SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM child GROUP BY parent_id) x ON x.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id, x.n

name: exists
sql: SELECT p.id FROM parent p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM child c WHERE c.parent_id=p.id)

name: not_exists
sql: SELECT p.id FROM parent p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM child c WHERE c.parent_id=p.id)

name: having_count
sql: SELECT c.parent_id, COUNT(*) FROM child c GROUP BY c.parent_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0

name: having_filtered_count
sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.state='open') FROM parent p LEFT JOIN child c ON c.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id HAVING COUNT(c.id) FILTER (WHERE c.state='open') > 0

name: cte_filtered
sql: WITH x AS (SELECT * FROM child WHERE state='open') SELECT p.id, COUNT(x.id) FROM parent p LEFT JOIN x ON x.parent_id=p.id GROUP BY p.id

name: subquery_filtered
sql: SELECT x.parent_id, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM child WHERE state='open') x GROUP BY x.parent_id
